title: Eleven Tonnes and One Meter
subtitle: 能源利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 能源利用（环境保护·能源与可再生）
meta: 主题语境：能源利用（环境保护·能源与可再生）　|　核心词汇：consumption　|　正文 334 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 consumption 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 my uncle ① measured the consumption of a house that used eleven tonnes a year, and he said the measuring was the whole of the winter. The ② consumption, meaning the using and not the meter, fell by a quarter and stayed down; consumption, he said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how little of it is noticed.

Every ③ consumption in that street had the same meter, and the ④ consumption at the end, meaning the one he kept for the coldest month and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever checked twice. Consumption, my aunt said, is nine parts noticing and one part somebody willing to turn it down; my uncle said the turning down is the part that fills the quarter.

My grandmother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ consumption was the whole of the cough, meaning the illness and not the using. The ⑥ consumption, meaning the illness and not any of that, is the only thing in a cough that everybody feared and nobody named; consumption, she said, is either something you measure or the only word that means both a using and an illness. He said the illness is the part they remember.

By 1980 the ⑦ consumption had become a line in a bill, and the bill had become an argument about the meter. The ⑧ consumption of the whole thing, my uncle wrote in December, was one house and thirty years of turning down; consumption, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to notice. She said the noticing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ consumption I remember is the one at the end, which he measured in 1986 and is still described as the lowest in the county. A ⑩ consumption, my aunt said in 1988, is the only thing that improves by being noticed; every consumption, she said, is an illness that has agreed to look like a using. She said the using was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 消耗；消耗量（能源、资源的使用量）
B. n. 消耗量（指那种使用本身，与那个仪表相对）
C. 固定搭配：measure the consumption of 计量……的消耗量
D. n. 消耗量（指那条街上每一户）
E. n. 消耗量（指末尾那一份）
F. n. 消耗；消费（指买东西、用东西的行为）
G. n. 消耗量（指账单里提到的那一项）
H. n. 消耗（抽象总称，旧义也指肺结核）

answers.why: measure the consumption of 意为“计量……的消耗量”，1972 年叔叔计量了一户一年烧掉十一吨的房子的消耗量。
consumption 意为“消耗量”，指那种使用本身而不是那个仪表，它降了四分之一，并且一直没回升。
consumption 指那条街上每一户的消耗量，每一户都装着同样的仪表。
consumption 指末尾那一份（他留给最冷月份的那一份），是唯一有人核对过两次的。
consumption 为旧义，指肺结核（consumption），祖母说那种病就是那阵咳嗽的全部，指的是病而不是消耗量。
consumption 为旧义用法，指那种病而不是消耗量，是咳嗽里人人都害怕、却无人点名的东西。
consumption 意为“消耗量”，指账单里提到的那一项，到 1980 年这项消耗量成了账单里的一行。
consumption 意为“消耗、消费”，叔叔十二月写道，整件事的消耗是一户人家三十年的调低用量。
consumption 意为“消耗量”，我记得的是末尾那一份，他 1986 年计量，至今仍被说成全县最低的。
consumption 为抽象总称，姑姑说消耗量是唯一会因为被留意而变好的东西。
